en.headline: Driver climbs from overturned van on Lin Cheung Road after early-morning crash
en.dek: Police said a 50-year-old man sustained abrasions to his hands and legs after his seven-seater hit a barrier near West Kowloon Station and flipped, but he declined hospital treatment.
body: A seven-seater van overturned on Lin Cheung Road in Yau Ma Tei early on Monday after striking a barrier, police said.

The vehicle was travelling toward Tsim Sha Tsui near the West Kowloon Station tunnel entrance at about 1.38am when it left the road, hit the left-side stone barrier and flipped onto its roof. The windscreen shattered, airbags deployed and items were scattered inside the vehicle.

The 50-year-old male driver climbed out on his own and waited for help. He sustained abrasions to his hands and legs. After examination at the scene he declined to go to hospital and assisted police with their investigation into the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 油麻地連翔道七人車撞壆翻側 司機自行爬出擦傷拒送院
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一凌晨約1時38分一輛七人車在西九龍站對開隧道自炒撞向石壆後四輪朝天，50歲男司機手腳擦傷，現場治理後毋須送院。
body: 警方表示，周一凌晨油麻地連翔道發生交通意外，一輛七人車撞向路旁石壆後翻側。
車輛沿連翔道往尖沙咀方向行駛，至西九龍高鐵站對開一隧道時，於凌晨約1時38分自炒撞向左邊石壆，車身翻轉四輪朝天。擋風玻璃爆裂，安全氣袋彈出，車內物件散落。
姓吳的50歲男司機自行爬出車外待援。他手及腳擦傷，經現場治理後毋須送院，並在場協助警員調查意外起因。
